student_verification.observation: One Blender build/render was run and save messages were returned. The trace contains no student image-opening, visual comparison, scene inspection, or revision after the render.

failures_and_recovery.observation: Blender reported a Material.use_nodes deprecation warning, not a traceback; no recovery is recorded. SDK ended successfully and all three requested deliverables were recorded present.

side_effects.observation: The script deletes selected existing scene objects before constructing the scene, and saves to absolute /app paths; this is a build operation, not evidence of damage to another reconstruction.

spatial_and_orientation_analysis.observation: Both images show a central two-pane window, repeated tables and white swivel chairs; the reconstruction is substantially more frontal and symmetric, with smaller foreground chairs and a higher visible wall/ceiling boundary. Reference perspective is oblique, with table edges and right wall receding and larger foreground furniture. These are image-space observations confounded by camera and layout, not aligned 3D errors.
evidence: user-supplied reference and delivered candidate images

spatial_and_orientation_analysis.observation: Student chairs are constructed facing +Y with the back toward the camera; the ang argument is unused, so all shells share an orientation. Individual reference chair yaw and hidden backs are only partly identifiable from one view.

The second constructed lamp lies outside the camera's horizontal frame by its unclipped projected bounding box; only one lamp is visible in the delivered view, whereas two appear in the reference. Bounds are not visibility masks.
evidence: user-supplied reference and delivered candidate images

appearance_and_resource_analysis.observation: Reference has dark tabletops and stronger warm lamp pools; the delivered render appears pale and relatively flat, with a much smaller window. Both show a fine hexagonal wall pattern and light floor. The seams are actual beveled curves rather than an image texture. Materials are assigned by mat() using Principled base color, roughness and metallic; the code does not construct image texture or mapping nodes, and does not load or pack an image resource. The output connection is not independently established here.
evidence: user-supplied reference and delivered candidate images

geometry_analysis.observation: Chairs use an ellipsoidal seat, subdivided solidified custom back mesh, central rod and five separate radial rods with sphere casters. Tables are ten independent rectangular tops with four rods each. Window panes are boxes placed in front of a solid frame box and wall, not demonstrated as an actual wall opening. The room and furniture are 3D geometry, not a full-reference image plane.
Evaluator lists 248 AABB overlap candidates; bounding-box overlap alone does not establish collision or a geometry defect.
